/** * Phase K41d · Feb-2026 — Bulk Operations audit tile. * * Renders a compact "Last 24h" summary of bulk admin actions on the * admin dashboard, wired against the existing ``bulk_actions_24h``, * ``bulk_actions_undone_24h`` and ``bulk_actions_expired_24h`` fields * on the admin ``/api/dashboard`` response. * * Data source (zero new endpoints): * * ``dashboard_drilldown_edit`` audit events, indexed by * ``event_type + timestamp + tenant_id + bulk_batch_id``. * * ``dashboard_drilldown_bulk_undone`` companion events. * * Design intent — give admins fast visibility over how many bulk * actions the team is running, how many were reversed, and how many * have aged past the 10-minute undo window (i.e. are now permanent * and could indicate a training or workflow issue). */ import React from "react"; import { Activity, RotateCcw, Clock } from "lucide-react"; export default function BulkOpsAuditTile({ data }) { // Defensive read — the fields are additive, so an older backend // build that hasn't shipped K41d yet returns ``undefined``. When // any of the three is missing we render nothing rather than a // "0 · 0 · 0" tile that would misrepresent the truth. if ( data == null || data.bulk_actions_24h == null || data.bulk_actions_undone_24h == null || data.bulk_actions_expired_24h == null ) { return null; } const total = Number(data.bulk_actions_24h) || 0; const undone = Number(data.bulk_actions_undone_24h) || 0; const expired = Number(data.bulk_actions_expired_24h) || 0; return (
Bulk operations · last 24h
{total} bulk actions {undone} undone 0 ? "text-amber-700" : "text-slate-800") } data-testid="bulk-ops-audit-tile-expired" > {expired} expired
); }
